faq.a: Five URL parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term and utm_content) that analytics tools read to show where a visit came from.
Yes. Analytics treat Youtube and youtube as different sources, so use lower case and hyphens instead of spaces. Spaces are encoded as %20 in the final URL.

faq.q: What happens to a link that already has parameters?
faq.a: The tool adds the UTM parameters after the existing ones instead of replacing them, so tracking information is merged rather than lost.
